properties.name: A2622/26 / LZBB
properties.originalText:
EXERCISE VOLCEX26 EXERCISE
VOLCANIC ASH EXERCISE VOLCEX26 WILL TAKE PLACE ON 18 NOVEMBER
2026 FROM 0800 UTC TO 1600 UTC.
THE EXERCISE WILL SIMULATE A CONTINUOUS ERUPTION OF VESUVIO
VOLCANO IN NAPLES (ITALY), WITH DISPERSION OF CONTAMINATING
ASH CLOUDS. DURING THE EXERCISE A NUMBER OF MESSAGES SUCH AS
VONA (VOLCANO OBSERVATORY NOTICE FOR AVIATION), NOTAM, VAA,
SIGMET WILL BE ISSUED AND WILL START WITH THE WARNING TEXT:
EXERCISE VOLCEX26 EXERCISE AND END WITH A WARNING TEXT:
EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE.
UPON RECEIVING THESE MESSAGES, AIRCRAFT OPERATORS SHALL NOT
TAKE ANY ACTION. ALL EXERCISE ACTIONS AND PROCEDURES SHALL NOT
AFFECT REAL LIFE OPERATIONS. IN THE EVENT OF AN ACTUAL VOLCANIC
ERUPTION THE EXERCISE WILL BE TERMINATED.
EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE
